decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The new arch shall be created with minimum disturbance to the wall; maximum re-use shall be made of the existing bricks. Any new bricks shall be compatable with the old in terms of appearance, texture, water absorption, strength, and bond pattern. Mortar shall be lime:sand using 3.5 natural hydraulic lime (N.H.L.) in proportion 1:2.5 sand, with well graded grit to fine mix, or as otherwise advised by specialist contractor. The mortar shall be flush and compacted by brush tamping, fully protected from frost and rapid drying.
description: Repairs to existing rear wall and erection of greenhouse in rear garden to house.
